ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   D. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
